resources.string: Join servers near you with good performance.
Gets you into a good server near you, without ever signing in to Roblox.
When you launch a game, Voidstrap checks the public server list and your region before Roblox opens.
Worked out from your time zone on this phone. Nothing is sent anywhere.
Skips servers that are running slowly.

Roblox only tells signed in apps where a server is, and the Play version of Voidstrap never signs in. So Smart Join learns where servers are from the games you actually join, and uses that to send you back to healthy servers near you.

When it does not know a server near you, Closest to you hands the join to Roblox's own server picking, which already chooses a server with low latency for your connection, instead of guessing.

Best performance picks the server with the best frame rate and player ping that is not full, ranks servers it knows are near you first, and skips servers it knows are far away.
Turn on activity tracking in Integrations so Smart Join can learn where the servers you join are.
